headline: Microsoft agent-framework PyPI compromise
label: CONFIRMED
latest: Versions 1.26.1 and 1.26.2 quarantined; how the upload was achieved is disputed.

log.text: Malicious releases published and quarantined within the hour.
Microsoft confirms removal and investigation; root cause unconfirmed.

headline: NVIDIA leak-site listing by Gentlemen ransomware
label: UNCONFIRMED CLAIM
latest: NVIDIA says it has seen no evidence of compromise; claim unverified.

log.text: Group lists NVIDIA; NVIDIA investigating possible third-party incident.

headline: Java4Shell OpenJDK flaw exploitation attempts
label: CONFIRMED
latest: Oracle and OpenJDK fixes out; CISA alert issued; attempts reported, no confirmed intrusions.
